caption: The drawing features a horizontal rectangular band set against a plain, off-white background. The band is divided into three main horizontal sections. The top and bottom sections are dark red in color and decorated with evenly spaced circular dot patterns in a slightly lighter red shade. The central section is turquoise and contains a continuous, repeating geometric Greek key pattern outlined in dark red, with the pattern itself rendered in turquoise. Near the right side of the band, there is a decorative circular motif comprised of small red circles arranged around a turquoise ring, breaking the uniformity of the pattern in that area. The overall composition is symmetrical except for the unique circular motif.
title: Wall Paper Border
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
